title: V114 versus Prevnar 13: the four solicited injection-site symptoms
question: In participants randomised to the 15-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine V114 or to the 13-valent comparator Prevnar 13, how does the risk of each solicited injection-site symptom compare?
_prose_rule: Every text field is PROSE unless it is on the numeric-text allowlist. Prose may not contain a bare numeral: any number it needs is a braced reference resolved at build time.
_sourcing_rule: Every MEASURED input names the source layer it came from. Values DERIVED by this build carry no source layer because they have no source: they are computed here and the validator recomputes them.

REGISTRY_CTGOV.name: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results: each category of each trial's solicited injection-site outcome, with its analysis denominators
REGISTRY_CTGOV.access_note: Each trial's posted results were retrieved from the registry API and read at CATEGORY level. The solicited injection-site outcome carries several categories; each is selected by its label and that label is recorded beside every cell it produced.

categories.detail: A placeholder identifier that resolves to nothing.
Heart-failure and chronic-kidney-disease trials. The SAME five appear in an unrelated lipid review in this corpus, which identifies them as one donor template rather than independent mistakes.
A dose-ranging study with eight arms that posts no solicited injection-site outcome and no clean two-arm comparison of the vaccine against the comparator.

removed_citations.disclosure_note: This app was rebuilt on its sourceable core. Of {rm.total_cited} citations in the source app, {rm.removed} were removed and {rm.retained} retained. The reduction is shown rather than absorbed.

completeness_statement: This reports every solicited injection-site symptom these trials post. Not every trial posts every symptom, and each outcome names the trials that contribute to it. It is a local tolerability review and covers neither immunogenicity nor protection against pneumococcal disease.

outcomes.name: Injection-site pain or tenderness
outcomes.definition: Percentage of participants reporting injection-site pain or tenderness within the trial's protocol-defined window after vaccination, read from the matching category of that trial's solicited injection-site outcome.
outcomes.definition_note: Each contributing trial posts this as a category of its own primary solicited injection-site outcome. The arms used and the observation window are recorded against each trial.

trials.arm_selection_note: This trial randomised TWO V114 formulations against one shared Prevnar 13 arm. An earlier build silently used the first formulation only.

trials.arm_selection_note: This is a five-group interchangeability trial of mixed schedules. Groups 2, 3 and 4 each receive Prevnar 13 for some doses and V114 for others, so none of them is a comparison of one vaccine against the other and none is used. The only clean contrast is Group 5, four doses of V114, against Group 1, four doses of Prevnar 13. An earlier build used Group 2, a mixed schedule, as the treatment arm.

injection_site_pain.not_poolable_reason: These trials differ in observation window and in who records the symptom, so no estimate is combined across all of them.
injection_site_pain.heterogeneity_status: not applicable; no overall synthesis is performed
injection_site_pain.reading_note: Strata are grouped by age. Each states what it mixes and its measured heterogeneity; read both with the estimate.
injection_site_pain.interpretation_caveat: This object records whether the symptom was registered as present, and nothing about how severe or how long-lasting it was. It says nothing about protection against disease.
